survivors.claim: port-check.js filters the walk by the `.test.js` extension, directly contradicting D3 ("walks every file under <root>/tests (location-based, no name or extension filter)"), the Gotcha it cites, and its own header comment ("every regular file under <root>/tests is walked"). A fixed or pid-derived port in tests/helpers.js — the exact file spec 06 made the port authority — or in any fixture, .js helper, or .txt under tests/ is invisible to doctor check 18.
survivors.impact: The doctor check the spec exists to add cannot see a fixed or computed port placed in the shared test helper, which is where the class it guards against most naturally returns.
survivors.evidence: Hunk (commit ec7b950, sole change): `- else if (ent.isFile()) out.push(full)` -> `+ else if (ent.isFile() && ent.name.endsWith('.test.js')) out.push(full)`. Executed repro — synthetic root with tests/helpers.js containing a pid-computed port and a listen(4173), tests/fixture.txt containing `--port 4599`, tests/real.test.js containing listen(4173): port-check printed only the .test.js hit, exit 1; the helper's and fixture's hits were silently dropped. The pre-filter version also exits 0 on this repo, so the narrowing is gratuitous. Fix: revert line 50.

survivors.claim: Commit ec7b950 changes spec/scripts/port-check.js after the branch's single bump and after the first two commits were merged to main, so the last behavior change lands unbumped relative to main.
survivors.impact: Hosts cannot tell the two behaviors apart by version. Moot once the extension filter is reverted.
survivors.evidence: plugin-bump.js --check with base auto-resolved to merge-base(HEAD, main) = 526f76d reports spec/ changed since 526f76d but version is 7.130.0.
